     - JP
     - ES

     - CN
     - HK
     - TW
- ### Tested on OneUI 7~9
- Thanks to all testers
### 😶‍🌫️ Features

     - Glow Text Animation

- Sensitive Information Protection

          - Series Number 
          - Phone Number

### 🗺 Project Overview - OneUI-Settings-Hook - Patches apply for Settings Apps from OneUI 7 + - Tested on OneUI 7 ~ 9 - LSPosed Latest Official and Root Required ### 😶‍🌫️ Features - ‼️ Redesign Software Info Page - Glow Text Animation - Customizable Text in Module Advanced Settings - You should read the "Disclaimer & Usage Notice" Part in Module Advanced Settings before Using - Software Info Card Background = Home Wall - Custom Dashboard Icon - OneUI Monet - OneUI 6 Monet - PUI Theme - Customizable Product Name - Sensitive Information Protection - Auto-Hide the following - IMEI - Series Number - Phone Number - Custom Fonts Detection Removed - Support Custom Fonts APK - Patch to make all app able to clone - Unlock Extra Battery Information - LSPosed Module Settings ### 📂 Preview
### ℹ️ How to use? - Install the .APK and activate in LSPosed - Give the app root permission - Open the module Settings (In LSPosed) and Force-Stop Settings App - Re-Open Settings App - Not applying ? Open a issue with your Software Details ### 🥰 Credits - In the App
